title: Brain-SAD: A Brain-Inspired Safe Autonomous Driving Control Framework with Dynamic Fear-Oriented Constraint on Dual-Policy
abstract: arXiv:2609.38016v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Constrained Reinforcement Learning has recently gained increasing attention in the field of Safe Autonomous Driving, where the general mechanism is to maximize the expected reward while keeping the overall action risk bounded. In this way, the safety issues arising in AD can be mitigated through constrained actions. However, existing Constrained RL methods still lack dynamics on the imposed constraints. For instance, the action cost adopted by the existing Primal-Dual/soft-constrained methods is often defined as static state-to-cost mapping, and the safe-action projection in hard-constrained methods relies on the static projection with the fixed feasible region boundary estimated from offline demonstrations. translated_title: Brain-SAD：一种基于双策略动态恐惧导向约束的类脑安全自动驾驶控制框架
translated_abstract: 约束强化学习近期在安全自动驾驶领域受到越来越多的关注，其一般机制是在保持整体动作风险有界的同时最大化期望奖励，从而通过受约束的动作来缓解自动驾驶中出现的安全问题。然而，现有的约束强化学习方法在所施加的约束上仍然缺乏动态性。例如，现有原始-对偶/软约束方法采用的动作代价通常被定义为静态的状态到代价映射，而硬约束方法中的安全动作投影则依赖于静态投影，其固定的可行域边界是从离线演示中估计得到的。上述缺点将所施加的约束与训练场景紧密耦合，由于不恰当的状态级动作代价和静态投影边界，导致自动驾驶策略难以应对不同的交互场景……
tldr: 该论文提出Brain-SAD框架，一种受大脑启发的安全自动驾驶控制方法，通过在双策略上施加动态恐惧导向约束，克服了现有约束强化学习中约束静态化、与训练场景紧密耦合而导致策略难以应对多样化交互场景的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Brain-SAD, a brain-inspired safe autonomous driving control framework that introduces dynamic fear-oriented constraints on a dual-policy, overcoming the limitation of static constraints in existing constrained RL methods that tightly couple policies to training scenarios and hinder adaptation to diverse interaction scenarios.
